frs.title: SQLite local DB schema (bond master, payment ledger, home_plan)
frs.text: The system SHALL store all data in a local SQLite database schema comprising a bond master table, a row-per-payment ledger table, and a home_plan table.
frs.source: brainstorm Decision Summary new-fr; Agreed Q3; doc-code §7

frs.title: Flask local web UI, no build step, offline, no accounts
Row-per-payment ledger rows instead of month columns
Excel-like month-grid UI derived from ledger rows
frs.source: brainstorm Agreed Q3; Decision Summary new-fr

frs.title: Dashboard figures as live queries/views (summary, this-month returns, 83-month history, status overview)
Fixed status rules — Danger = ANY unpaid past month, Completed overrides, zero = unpaid
CSV export for sharing/printing
One-time XLSM import script; Excel kept read-only backup
frs.source: brainstorm Agreed Q2; Decision Summary new-fr

frs.title: Derived totals as queries (Till Rerun = SUM payments; Balance = Till Rerun - Maturity)
Bond master data reproduced for all 15 bonds
Watch-list analytics formulas reproduced (discount, TDS, per-month, qty TL)
Home Plan savings schedule reproduced incl. irregular savings 39588/10063/0
Discount amount per bond (owner wish)
TDS deduction on payouts (owner wish)
Quarterly/yearly payout cycles (owner wish; validation list '1 Monthly, 4 Quartely')
Dashboard P&L and ongoing bond TL value (owner wish)
Reinvestment free-up: duplicate deduction only for Ongoing/Danger, Completed principal freed (owner: 'most important feature')
Dynamic month headers for full range, no hardcoded Feb-2027 window
Bonds starting Feb-2031+ get status/formatting (Jan-2031 scan limit removed)
Dashboard updates immediately on data change — no open/save trigger dependence
Surface errors to user; no silent swallowing (no 'On Error Resume Next' equivalent)
Duplicate ISN validation across full bond set (not just D7 + D14:D16)
Stable schema keys instead of header-text/column-position coupling
Status recomputes on payment history change without open/save events

nfrs.requirement: Entirely offline operation for all features.
Local SQLite only; no cloud, accounts, or outbound transmission.
Any desktop OS, Python + browser only, no build step.
Single documented launch command; dashboard within 1 minute on clean machine.
Business logic centralized (SQL views / one module); no recreated header coupling.
nfrs.source: Mission 'easy to maintain'; doc-code header coupling

nfrs.requirement: Errors surfaced visibly; no swallowed failures.
Dashboard/status recomputed on next view; never a stale snapshot.
nfrs.source: doc-code 'dashboard stale between saves'; Agreed Q3

nfrs.requirement: Danger = ANY past unpaid month; Completed overrides; zero = unpaid.
No hardcoded date headers or scan-window limits.
Import reproduces full dataset; totals reconcile exactly (15 bonds, 1037142.01, 111638.57).
Dashboard < 2s with 150 bonds x 96 months, no schema change.
nfrs.source: Mission 'scalable as the data grows' (numeric target SUGGESTED, needs user confirm)

nfrs.requirement: CSV export of any displayed dataset.
DB file is sole persistence artifact; transferable by file copy.

userStories.text: As a user, I keep all data offline on my own system with no cloud/accounts, so I stay in full control.
As a friend receiving the app, I run it with Flask and a browser on any OS with no build step.
As the owner, I see which completed bonds freed their principal so I can reinvest it.
As the owner, I export data to CSV for sharing/printing since Excel is no longer the front end.
As the owner, I view a live dashboard (totals, status counts, this-month returns, 83-month history) without opening Excel.

successMetrics.text: Import reconciles exactly: 15 bonds, Total Investment 1037142.01, Total Till Return 111638.57, Total Balance -925503.44.
Dashboard always current — no open/save event required to reflect latest entry.
Danger flags every unpaid past month; Completed overrides; zero counts unpaid.
Bond starting Feb-2031+ gets correct status and grid rendering (Jan-2031 limit gone).

dataEntities.text: Bond master: status, purchase date, broker, ISN, company, rating, principle TL, tenure, maturity date/amount, interest start, payment type.
Payment ledger: bond ref, month, amount, paid flag (Sep-2025..Jul-2032).
Home Plan schedule: month index 1..84, saving (incl. 39588/10063/0), rate, per-year interest, countdown, remaining interest; totals row.
Watch-list analytics fields: face value, principle, T.L.P, discount, per-month, 10% TDS, 12-month, qty, TL principle.
Derived totals (query-only, never stored): Till Rerun, Balance, status.

errors.text: Bonds beyond old Jan-2031 scan window must not be silently skipped.
Zero-value payment treated as unpaid (Danger check applies).
Unresolvable current month for This Month Returns → explicit message, not silent 0.
Duplicate ISN flagged across entire bond set.
XLSM import failures reported explicitly, never silently swallowed.
Home Plan formula/static mix: import preserves stored values.

conflicts.note: FR-17 priority must + owner calls it 'most important feature', but fr-extractor tagged phase P4-wishlist. RESOLVED: moved to phase1/MVP. Same for US-03 (was P4).
FR-21 is 'should' but NFR-6 states the same no-silent-errors rule as a SHALL (non-negotiable). Treat as mandatory; recommend FR-21 priority = must.
Both demand live, non-stale dashboard. FR-05 = values computed as queries; FR-20 = no open/save trigger dependence. Overlapping — merge acceptance criteria; keep both ids for traceability.
NFR-8 restates FR-06 status rules verbatim as data-integrity. Keep rule in FR-06; NFR-8 carries only the verification obligation.
Same requirement (full-coverage duplicate ISN check) appears as FR and ERR row. Keep FR-22 as requirement, ERR-04 as failure-behavior spec.
Analytics FR in phase3 but its fields imported in phase1 (DATA-04 phase1 per fr-extractor P1-data). Acceptable: data lands early, formulas later.
fr-extractor: FR-12 phase P2-ui but priority should, while DATA-03 tagged P1-data. RESOLVED: Home Plan entity + FR-12 both moved to phase3 (non-MVP).

mvp.rationale: Phase 0 — bootstrap: project skeleton, Python/Flask/SQLite deps, test harness, HF-05 parser spike (no FR ids; prerequisite only). Phase 1 = MVP: all 15 'must' FRs — schema+ledger (FR-01/03), import (FR-08/09/10), Flask UI + grid (FR-02/04), fixed status engine (FR-06), live dashboard (FR-05/20), CSV export (FR-07), quirk fixes (FR-18/19/24), and FR-17 reinvestment free-up (must + owner's 'most important feature' — promoted from fr-extractor's P4 tag, see conflicts). Phase 2 — robustness: FR-21/22/23 + ERR-03/04 (error surfacing, dup-ISN, decoupling). Phase 3 — Home Plan + watch-list analytics: FR-11/12, DATA-03/04 consumption, ERR-06. Phase 4 — remaining owner wish-list: FR-13/14/15/16 (discount, TDS, quarterly/yearly, P&L + ongoing TL value). Mission demands 'full rebuild' (Interview 3), so MVP = complete Excel replacement; wish-list additions staged after.

gaps: HF-09 coloring/display rules have no explicit FR — doc-code §2.3/§4.9 requires status+cell colors; propose adding an FR (or extending FR-04) to cover conditional-formatting replacement. NEEDS USER/PARENT DECISION.
NFR-11 numeric targets (2s, 150 bonds) are suggested by nfr-checker, not user-stated — confirm with user (zero-hallucination rule).
No FR for header typo renaming (Staus/Yeild/ISN...) — fr-extractor deliberately skipped; new schema field names imply it, but no user statement exists. Confirm.
US/SM numbering: fr-extractor produced 5 US + 4 SM; no separate us/story or metric scout ran — counts final unless parent expects more.
FR-21 priority mismatch (should vs NFR-6 SHALL) needs parent adjudication.
No explicit won't/Not-wanted exclusions (brainstorm 'Not wanted = none'), so no out-of-scope list exists.
Traceability: all 24 FRs, 13 NFRs, 9 helpers, 5 US, 4 SM, 5 DATA, 6 ERR trace to brainstorm.md or doc-code-analysis.md — zero untraced items (FR-22 zero-hallucination check PASS).
